action: taekwondo side kick (yop chagi) from fighting stance
intent: Deliver a powerful linear side kick to a high/chest-head height target and return to stable guard.

key_body_parts: right leg fully extended to side

balance: Weight stays entirely on single supporting left leg during chamber/kick/retract with torso counter-leaning opposite the kick for stability, then redistributed evenly to both feet on recovery.
hard_parts: Single-leg balance with high leg extension and large torso lean will be hardest due to high center-of-mass shift, required hip abduction/external rotation, and need for precise ankle stabilization to avoid tipping.
edits: kick lower to waist height for stability
hold extended kick for 2 seconds before retracting
do slower chamber with front-facing torso instead of side lean
